# Domain and generation contract

This is a design brief, not evidence about a particular airline. The exercise concerns reservations, time-limited seat holds and conflicting updates. Set a local investigation in that domain without supplying a prior incident, cast, personal record, code excerpt or screenshot as a pattern. Any local records must be invented from scratch after the [input gate](../SECURITY.md).

Use the caller's newly invented system label. An airline label and code are optional; if the local UI needs them, invent them independently rather than looking them up. Keep the application name distinct from stable checker-facing paths.

Separate presentation, application and persistence. Build the default path with plain local HTML, CSS and JavaScript plus local state; opening it must not require an API, internet connection, container, remote font or build step. Draw an original Windows 95-style desktop with gray panels, beveled controls and visible keyboard focus. Keep an optional local service independent from that path.

Create all content and its provenance in the separate destination. Produce a truthful local screen capture and label personas and scenarios as invented, not user research. The public formula ships neither a reference instance nor a source-template application.
